description: Interconnection application received for 40 MW solar project at Elkhorn Farm Phase II. Application fee paid. Assigned to Study Engineering queue.
1st Deficiency Notice issued — missing protection relay settings for FDR-2201 POI. Applicant notified. 10-day response window opened.
Deficiency response received. Protection relay settings submitted. Smart Inverter Confirmation documentation accepted.
Application Deemed Complete. Queue position confirmed. Task 2001 (Application Review) closed — APPROVED in 32 days.
Initial Review (IR) started. Assigned to Elena Vasquez. FDR-2201 identified as point of interconnection. EGI Pre-IR Review (Task 2004) initiated.
Task 2004 (EGI Pre-IR Review) completed. Scope confirmed: 40 MW solar, FDR-2201. Task 2005 (Conduct: IR) defaulted to sequential queue — not yet started.
AI agent flagged: Task 2005 has been in queue 23 days with no start. 312 comparable projects show parallel start is safe — 0 re-study events. Estimated 8 BD saving. HITL card surfaced to coordinator.
HITL card generated: Approve Parallel Execution of Task 2005. Card pending coordinator decision.
Application received for 38.5 MW combined solar+storage project. Fresno Agricultural Solar Cluster. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility study assigned to Aisha Patel. Central Valley Substation CV-07 identified as point of interconnection.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED at 35 MW. Substation CV-07 initial screening acceptable. Escalated to SIS for full capacity study.
SIS completed — CONDITIONAL. T-CV07-B transformer upgrade ($2.1M) required. Cost estimate letter sent to applicant. Proceeding to Detailed Study.
Detailed Study assigned to Marcus Reid. SCADA communication design initiated.
Detailed Study completed — APPROVED. Agreement Review queue assignment requested. Central Valley Agreement Review queue has 5 projects ahead.
Applicant submitted written dispute of $2.1M cost estimate. Disputed items: transformer upgrade scope allocation, 15.3 miles of distribution line upgrade. Dispute logged in Agreement Review.
Escalation issued. Cost estimate dispute unresolved at day 178. ITC eligibility window flagged as critical. Agreement Review Manager notified.
Application received for 4.8 MW wind project, Marin County. Assigned to Study Engineering. Fast Track screening initiated.
Feasibility assigned to Elena Vasquez. FDR-3407 identified as point of interconnection.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED. FDR-3407 at 58% capacity — acceptable. Escalated to SIS due to wind generation profile requirements.
SIS assigned to Elena Vasquez. Voltage regulation analysis at injection point commenced.
Clarification requested from applicant: wind turbine reactive capability datasheet required for voltage regulation model. 10-day response window issued.
Clarification received. Wind turbine reactive capability datasheet received and entered into power flow model. Analysis resuming.
SLA breach notice issued. SIS at day 89 — 1 day from 90-day limit. AI analysis completed. Emergency engineer co-assignment under review.
Application received for 25 MW battery storage project, Tracy. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility assigned to James Thornton. FDR-5501 identified as point of interconnection.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED. FDR-5501 capacity adequate for storage configuration. Proceeding to SIS.
SIS assigned to James Thornton. Arc flash and protection coordination analysis commenced.
SIS completed — CONDITIONAL. Arc flash hazard identified at tie-switch. Dedicated relay required ($340K). Proceeding to Detailed Study.
Detailed Study opened. James Thornton initially assigned but reassigned to critical project in April. Aisha Patel assigned July 2025 after 3-month gap.
Document request issued to applicant: as-built protection coordination diagram required for arc flash analysis. 15-day response window.
SLA breach notification. Detailed Study at day 156 with no document response. Study Engineering Manager notified. Project escalated.
Application received for 18.2 MW EV charging hub, Port of Stockton. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility assigned to Elena Vasquez. FDR-6601 (port area) identified.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED. FDR-6601 capacity adequate for EV charging load profile.
SIS completed — CONDITIONAL. T-SS06-A transformer upgrade ($870K) required. Cost estimate issued to applicant.
Applicant filed written dispute of $870K transformer cost. Claims upgrade serves broader grid and should not be solely applicant's responsibility.
EVSE technical specification document request issued. UL 2202/UL 2594 certifications required for protection coordination review.
Formal dispute notice filed by applicant's legal team. Agreement Review paused pending dispute resolution. AI escalation recommendation generated.
Application received for 12.5 MW solar campus, San Jose South. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility assigned to James Thornton. FDR-1102 identified as point of interconnection. Fast Track screening initiated.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED. Fast Track screening failed MW threshold (>10 MW). Routed to SIS path. Assigned to Elena Vasquez.
SIS assigned to Elena Vasquez. Voltage regulation analysis on FDR-1102 commenced. Note: engineer currently also assigned to pge-001 SIS.
Internal bandwidth alert generated. Elena Vasquez now primary on 3 active SIS projects (pge-001, pge-003, pge-006). Load rebalancing under review.
Application received for 3.2 MW fuel cell plant, Napa Valley. Assigned to Study Engineering. Fast Track path initiated.
Feasibility assigned to James Thornton. Fast Track screening underway. Fuel cell manufacturer datasheet requested.
Clarification requested: fuel cell manufacturer datasheet not received after 5-month project duration. Formal 10-day notice issued.
SLA AT_RISK status assigned. Feasibility study at day 44 of 60-day Fast Track limit. Applicant follow-up sent.
Application received for 7.8 MW community solar, Antioch. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility assigned to Aisha Patel. Group study flag triggered: 4 adjacent applications on FDR-0801 feeder cluster.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED. Group study formally triggered. Coordination with pge-012 and pge-014 initiated. Applicants notified of group study process.
Group Study SIS opened. Aisha Patel coordinating simultaneous power flow analysis for all group study participants.
Group study SIS active at day 55. Group study timeline review issued — 60-90 additional days expected. Applicants to be formally re-notified of revised timeline.
Application received for 22 MW data center solar, Sacramento. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED. Behind-the-meter configuration reduces grid impact.
SIS completed — APPROVED. No major grid impacts. Detailed Study opened.
Detailed Study completed — APPROVED. CPUC backup generation clause requires compliance review. Referred to Agreement Review.
Clarification requested from Compliance team: CPUC backup generation compliance review scope defined. 15-day internal review target set.
Agreement execution blocked pending Compliance review. Escalation issued to Agreement Review Manager. Target resolution: Dec 15.
Application received for 15.5 MW wind+storage hybrid, Monterey Peninsula. Assigned to Study Engineering.
SIS completed — CONDITIONAL. Hybrid storage dispatch modeled. 6 mitigation items accepted by applicant.
Detailed Study completed — APPROVED. All mitigation items resolved. Cost estimate issued. NTP preparation initiated.
Interconnection Agreement executed by both parties. NTP issued. Construction phase commenced.
Construction started. Utility-side equipment procurement confirmed. Field engineer assigned.
Two RFIs opened by field engineer on protection relay settings. Study Engineering review requested. Construction otherwise on schedule. AI analysis available.
Application received for 2.1 MW biogas generator, Fresno. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Detailed Study opened. Marcus Reid assigned. CAISO biogas screening in parallel.
Document request issued to applicant: protection coordination supplement and CAISO screening results required. 15-day response window.
Second document request issued. No response received. 10-day final notice.
Study formally stalled. Final suspension notice issued to applicant. Project placed on hold pending document receipt.
Application received for 9 MW industrial rooftop solar, Richmond. Fast Track path. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Fast Track feasibility assigned to James Thornton. FDR-0904 at 44% capacity — favorable.
Clarification received from group study coordination: pge-012 may be included in feeder cluster group study. Engineer notified. Timeline under review.
Fast Track feasibility ongoing, day 41. No issues identified. Group study scope may extend to include pge-012 — monitoring.
Application received for 50 MW utility-scale solar, Bakersfield. Largest project in current queue. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility assigned to Aisha Patel. Central Valley feeder cluster analysis initiated. Grid capacity concern flagged immediately.
Internal grid capacity alert: pge-013 combined with pge-002 (38.5 MW) and pge-004 (25 MW) represents 113.5 MW on infrastructure rated ~90 MW. Transmission planning team notified.
Feasibility at day 22. CAISO pre-screening recommended by AI analysis. Transmission planning meeting scheduled for Dec 20.
Application received for 1.2 MW rooftop solar portfolio, San Francisco. Fast Track. 14 sites, distributed load.
Feasibility assigned to James Thornton. Distributed site analysis initiated. Group study coordination check completed — not included in Antioch cluster.
Feasibility ongoing, day 15. No issues. Engineer has capacity. On track for Fast Track approval.
Application received for 3.5 MW public EV charging hub, Concord. Fast Track. Assigned to Study Engineering.
Feasibility assigned to Elena Vasquez. Concord substation recently upgraded — good capacity.
Feasibility ongoing, day 10. Substation available capacity confirmed. On track for completion within 30 days.
Application received for 5.5 MW community solar, Elk Grove. Fast Track path. New substation capacity available.
Feasibility assigned to Marcus Reid. Elk Grove substation Q3 2025 upgrade confirmed with 25 MW available capacity.
Feasibility ongoing, day 18. No issues. Elk Grove capacity easily accommodates 5.5 MW. On track for Fast Track approval.
Application received for 8 MW onshore collection substation, Half Moon Bay. Peninsula region.
SIS completed — APPROVED. Peninsula transmission access confirmed. Cost estimate issued.
Interconnection Agreement finalized by PG&E legal team. Sent to applicant for execution.
Agreement paused — applicant legal team has not returned signed agreement after 18 days. Formal reminder issued. AI recommendation to follow up generated.
Application received for 6 MW BESS, Roseville. Assigned to Study Engineering.
SIS completed — APPROVED with minor protection relay note. Conditional approval met. Agreement executed.
NTP issued. Construction started. All permits secured. Utility equipment installation began.
Construction complete. Utility equipment installed. Protection settings verification pending before witness test scheduling.
Application received for 4.2 MW solar+storage, San Mateo. Assigned to Study Engineering.
SIS completed — APPROVED. No mitigation required. Agreement executed immediately. NTP issued. Construction started.
Witness test completed successfully. All protection relay tests passed. CPUC notification filing submitted.
Energization scheduled for December 22. Final confirmation issued to applicant and field operations team.
Application received for 0.8 MW biogas cogeneration, Modesto. Fast Track. Smallest project in queue.
Feasibility completed — APPROVED. Fast Track cleared. Low grid impact. Proceeding to SIS.
SIS completed ahead of schedule. No mitigation required. Agreement executed. Construction started.
Construction complete. As-built drawings submitted. Compliance review complete.
Witness test scheduled for December 19. Field inspector assigned. Applicant attendance confirmed.
